identificationModule.officialTitle: Clinical Trial of CD19/CD22 Dual Target CAR-T Cells in the Treatment of Relapsed/Refractory B-cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Prospectively evaluate the safety and effectiveness of CD19/CD22 dual-target CAR-T cells in the treatment of relapsed/refractory B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia. Strictly follow the inclusion criteria to screen eligible subjects for inclusion in clinical trials. The selected patients received CD19/CD22 dual-target CAR-T cell therapy. After the treatment is over, follow-up regularly to determine the survival status and follow-up treatment.

primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of initial treatment to the end of follow up, up to 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of surviving patients at the end of the study.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From admission to the end of follow up, up to 2 years.
